definition: A fragrant resin burned for its pleasant smell.
author: Dante Alighieri
quote: Blade nor herb throughout his life He tastes, but tears of frankincense alone And odorous amomum: swaths of nard And myrrh his funeral shroud.
example_sentence: The old chapel still smelt faintly of frankincense.
